description: Free, no payment. One call tells you whether a paid fetch tool would most likely succeed on a URL: DNS/public check, HTTP status, final URL after redirects (robots.txt checked on every hop), response time, robots.txt for the shop's agent and for *, content type, length and charset, and a verdict per tool (or for every eligible fetch tool) with the reason, price, paid endpoint and whether the free trial covers it. Never returns page content. Limited per IP per day.

tool.description: Optional: the paid tool you plan to call (default: every eligible fetch tool)

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain

name: preflight
title: Free preflight: will a paid fetch succeed on this URL?
